site_and_stakeholder_evidence.claim_rule: Do not claim resident validation, site knowledge, stakeholder endorsement or field performance until authorized dated evidence exists.

assumptions.statement: Official boundary, road redlines, station entrances, ownership, utilities, traffic controls and engineering constraints are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: All geometry and spatial metrics remain provisional design evidence and must be recalculated after an official revision.

assumptions.statement: Enterprise commute, freight, shuttle, charging and visitor demand is not available as a consented grouped register.
assumptions.impact: No capacity, modal split or queue claim is made; P0 must establish a dated and privacy-preserving demand baseline.

assumptions.statement: Resident daily access, night return, care load, accessibility and perceived safety have no project-specific stratified baseline.
assumptions.impact: Resident targets are pilot gates, not current outcomes; human, telephone and paper routes remain mandatory.

assumptions.statement: Curb inventory, occupancy, turnover, loading, enforcement, signal timing and obstruction logs are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: The five curb states are a governance taxonomy, not existing capacity or a parking allocation.

assumptions.statement: Station entrances, platform access, walking buffers, bicycle parking and transfer reliability are not measured for the study area.
assumptions.impact: The rail/bus spine is a design intention; route and service levels require traffic and accessibility review.

assumptions.statement: Gradients, crossings, tactile paving, signals, obstructions, shade and alternate routes are not field verified.
assumptions.impact: No accessible-route completion or equality claim can be made until a professional audit and resident participation are complete.

assumptions.statement: Asset owners, procurement, operating contracts, maintenance budgets, insurance and complaint SLAs are unknown.
assumptions.impact: P0/P1 are tasks and gates, not funded construction or operating commitments.

assumptions.statement: No personal trajectories, camera feeds, consent records or retention schedules are available or assumed.
assumptions.impact: The package uses grouped demand only and requires purpose limitation, deletion ownership and public algorithm notes before a trial.

assumptions.statement: No vehicle, operator, approval, route, insurance or road-opening authorization is included for autonomous or on-demand feeder services.
assumptions.impact: Feeders remain conditional, low-speed, human-supervised and reversible; rail and bus remain the backbone.

assumptions.statement: Shade, heat, drainage, water, lighting, ecology and winter maintenance data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Blue-green interfaces are fallback design directions, not flood, health or thermal-performance claims.

assumptions.statement: Workplace charging research indicates a demand/supply planning risk but does not supply a Beijing or project baseline.
assumptions.impact: Charging is an unknown metric until employers and facility owners provide a joint inventory and demand survey.

assumptions.statement: A change to official boundary, transport network, station access or demand revision must regenerate geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, drawings and self-check together.
assumptions.impact: No single visual refresh may be used to claim completion.

assumptions.statement: External commuting origins and destinations cross the provisional boundary, but no consented grouped OD, mode split, parking inflow or cross-line transfer sample is available.
assumptions.impact: External commute metrics stay unknown; P0 must use dated grouped counts and preserve origin/destination privacy.

assumptions.statement: The package has no local signal timing, station capacity, bicycle behaviour, pedestrian conflict or wheelchair movement calibration dataset.
assumptions.impact: SUMO and other simulation methods remain reproducible scaffolds; no simulated value is reported as current performance.

assumptions.statement: No airspace, route, airworthiness, operator, insurance, weather, fire, noise, emergency or public-participation approval exists for an air-mobility experiment.
assumptions.impact: Air mobility is a conditional ground-first candidate only; no route, vertiport, flight or construction commitment is made.

assumptions.statement: Pedestrian, bicycle, wheelchair, vehicle and evacuation movements need a professional conflict and safety model with field observation.
assumptions.impact: People-flow conflict and overall-efficiency metrics remain unknown until hard safety gates and field calibration are complete.

assumptions.statement: The 3,122,000-agent activity-chain replay, six group weights and C1/C2/C3 policy bundles are declared synthetic proxies for comparative screening, not observed workforce, resident, school, visitor or external-commute demand.
assumptions.impact: The selected 91.88 value is an internal composite mobility-pressure proxy only; before any operational decision, dated grouped OD, enterprise scheduling, resident access, accessibility, curb and service-reliability inputs must replace or calibrate these assumptions without collecting personal trajectories.
